    n = len(grid)
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    fill = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    return [[grid[r][c] if r < n and c < n else fill for c in range(2 * n)] for r in range(2 * n)]
'''
